description: Savantis Memory gives your assistants one memory that belongs to you. Recall preferences and decisions across conversations, add new memories with user approval, organize them into spaces, and manage confirmed references that take priority over inferred memories. Contradictions remain visible instead of being silently overwritten, and each item can be corrected, exported, or deleted.

defaultPrompt: Recall anything from my Savantis memory that could help answer this question.
